notes.title: Keep your game progress!
notes.content:
Resume

As the game became longer and harder, we've added an ability to continue your game from the wave you finished. And this game update also includes an ability to keep that wave even between game launches so you can keep slicing these droids!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37912038/1ef2aa320ed4599f4724e49f932969961c17154e.jpg

Tutorial

We have added quick tips before every wave to describe energysabers capabilities. Let us know if you discover something new!

Menu
To start in a more comfortable environment we introduced the hangar menu, where you can select your level to play, new levels are coming here as well!

Feedback and free keys

Try it out and let us know, what do you think. Please join our Discord server to share your feedback or get a free Steam key as an early adopter of the Energysaber Masta VR.

notes.title: A new droid Hummingbird for you and your force shield
notes.content:
New Update - New Droids

Please meet a new droid - "Hummingbird", very cute and nice but pretty aggressive. Stay alert and don't let him pierce you with his energy bullets. Your force shield can block and absorb the bullets but you still need to figure out how to deal with the hummingbird.

notes.title: Bindings for the Valve Index headset
notes.content:
Supported VR Headsets

In the most recent update, we have fixed the bindings for the Valve Index headset and now fully support 4 VR Headsets/Controllers:

- Valve Index
- Oculus Rift
- Oculus Quest
- HTC Vive

Please let us know if we need to adopt more headsets, we will be happy to do so!

Controls and contronllers

As a quick guide, the full list of controls available is below:

1. Index trigger (primary and secondary) - Fire railgun
2. Hand trigger, or Grab (primary and secondary) - Activate force shield
3. Button 1 - Enable saber (optional)
4. Button 2 - Enable second saber side (optional, double-sided)

Is it convenient? Do you want to change something? Let us know, post your comment on the discussion board.

notes.title: Energysaber Masta VR - first game update!
notes.content:
Game update!

The first and not the last update of the game brings you an ability to traverse the spaceship in order to advance in your quest. With every new location, it's harder to protect yourself but with your new railguns and powerful energy lasers, you can do it!

What's new:

- new lasers
- new drones
- new locations 
- and portals!
